editorial:
Imagine you are hanging out with a few friends in Griffith Park when everything suddenly goes wrong. You follow Jessica and Dave, who get snatched up along with three other couples by something they cannot even see. The vibe is tense and scary from the start because you feel just as lost and confused as the characters. It starts as a simple kidnapping story, but it quickly turns into a wild ride where these strangers have to trust each other if they want to make it out alive. You will find yourself rooting for them as they scramble to find a way home while facing a threat that is way beyond anything they expected.

What really works here is how the mystery unfolds and the way the tension builds up. The acting feels natural, and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually in control. While some of the special effects are a bit basic, the fast pace makes up for it. If you love movies where normal people are thrown into crazy situations, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out that the kidnappers are actually aliens who have been experimenting on humans. After a desperate struggle to escape, the survivors realize that the world they knew is gone. The twist is that the abductors have already changed the planet, meaning there is no safe home to go back to. It ends on a dark note, showing that the humans were just pawns in a much bigger, scarier plan for Earth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves alien mysteries and survival stories.
